title: MS 251 C Identity & Manual Entry Remediation

reproduction_details.dossier_behavior_before: frozen - no specs, no save possible

root_cause.manual_free_text_behavior_before: USER_REPORTED_UNVERIFIED_MODEL status set, UI shows warning but user cannot proceed to save dossier
root_cause.dossier_behavior_before: USER_REPORTED_UNVERIFIED_MODEL not in DOSSIER_SAVEABLE_IDENTITY_STATUSES, dossier blocked

source_identity_review.evidence_used: Official service manual 0455-737-0223 (STIHL MS 231, 251 Manuel de service)

implementation.dossier_behavior: MS 251 C can now be saved as USER_CONFIRMED_MODEL
implementation.decoder_behavior: MS 251 / C normalizes to MS 251 C, returns success with technical specs

tests.targeted_tests: Updated phase38c and phase38d tests to reflect MS 251 C registration
tests.global_search_tests: MS 251 C searchable, MS 251 isolated, variant isolation preserved
tests.manual_ux_tests: Improved warning text for unverified models

tests.regressions: None expected - all changes are additive

affected_records: Added ms-251-c to model_index in public_evidence_facts.json

final_decision: CANDIDATE PASS - All acceptance criteria met. MS 251 C registered as canonical identity with evidence basis. Search normalization works. Dossier saveable. Manual free-text UX improved. Unknown models remain unverified.
